title: Figure 1. Communication Link Block Diagram: full duplex gravitational wave link
description: Block diagram titled "Full Duplex Communication Link Using Gravitational Wave Generators and Sensors", showing Station 1 (GW Generator "Xmit 1", GW Sensor "Rcvr 1") and Station 2 (GW Sensor "Rcvr 2", GW Generator "Xmit 2") exchanging "Signal 1 + Source Noise" and "Signal 2 + Source Noise" with "Additional Link Noise" at frequencies ω1 and ω2.
